summary: People call it "procedural anxiety at masterpiece level," and that is the pitch: journalism, corporate pressure, and Michael Mann making moral dread feel cinematic.
good_pick_if: you want adult thriller energy without cheap thrills
maybe_skip_if: you want action set pieces or lighter stakes

summary: People call it "romantic espionage perfection," and that feels earned. It is all chemistry, suspense, and elegant Hitchcock craftsmanship.
good_pick_if: you want old-Hollywood suspense with real romantic charge
maybe_skip_if: you want something rougher or less polished

summary: People describe it as "ghost story guilt trip," and that is a good invitation: eerie silent-horror atmosphere with a surprisingly emotional moral ache.
good_pick_if: you want atmospheric old horror with soul
maybe_skip_if: you want modern pacing or less allegory

summary: People call it "all steel and momentum," and that really is the fun: war-thriller mechanics executed with muscular old-school confidence.
good_pick_if: you want a sturdy, high-tension classic thriller
maybe_skip_if: you want softer character drama or more modern speed

summary: People call it "hospital nightmare nonsense," and that is a compliment. It is creepy, funny, and so idiosyncratic that the whole thing feels gloriously infected.
good_pick_if: you want horror that is eerie, funny, and very odd
maybe_skip_if: you want tidy plotting or conventional scares

summary: People call it "deliciously toxic," and that is the correct mood going in: razor-sharp nastiness, tabloid satire, and Fincher at full slick-control power.
good_pick_if: you want a twisty, mean, extremely watchable thriller
maybe_skip_if: you want warmth or healthier relationship energy

summary: People call it "all neon and loneliness," and that is why it lands so hard: professional-criminal cool wrapped around a surprisingly sad emotional core.
good_pick_if: you want stylish crime cinema with grown-up sadness
maybe_skip_if: you want lighter caper fun or less mood

summary: People call it "conspiracy cinema on overdrive," and that is the deal: huge information rush, righteous anger, and Oliver Stone style turned all the way up.
good_pick_if: you want a big, propulsive political rabbit hole
maybe_skip_if: you want calm restraint or a neutral viewpoint

summary: People describe it as "sweaty swamp terror," and that is the right warning. It is primal, sexy, unnerving horror that feels sticky and inescapable.
good_pick_if: you want horror that feels raw, strange, and physical
maybe_skip_if: you want clean modern scares or emotional safety

summary: People call it "a subway heist banger," and that is honestly enough. It is funny, hard-edged, and packed with grimy seventies New York propulsion.
